concerns: One MAJOR defect: dashboard.js:1276 reads `p.candidate_executor` but shadow.ts emits `candidate_executor_used`. The executor column in the shadow variants strip always displays '—'. Fix: `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`.

findings.description: Field name mismatch between producer and consumer: shadow.ts records the candidate executor as `candidate_executor_used` (lines 70, 93, 132, 141), but dashboard.js:1276 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor`. Neither field exists in the payload, so the executor column always renders '—'. Fix: change to `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`.
